brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.requirement: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface: one centre hex base with six hex bases around it, on one level.
requirements.evidence: Six hex bases (piece family, full) at axial (-1,0), (-1,1), (0,-1), (0,1), (1,-1), (1,0) around the centre base at (0,0), all level 0. get_build reports 7 piece parts.

requirements.requirement: The work surface is covered on top (covers closing the top faces of the bases).
requirements.evidence: Seven full top covers (cover family, face top), one on each base, cover:-1,0 through cover:1,0.

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge of the honeycomb is finished with a cap.
requirements.evidence: 18 caps (cap family) on the six outer cells, three per cell on the outside faces. No OPEN_CAP_FACE issue is reported by check_build. Check_build reports meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: The surface is a single level (one storey).
requirements.evidence: All pieces, covers and caps are at level 0; no level-1 parts.

finish.summary: Built a seven-cell honeycomb work surface on one level: a centre full hex base with six around it, a full top cover on each of the seven cells, and 18 caps closing every open outside edge of the six outer cells. check_build shows meshClash clear and no rule errors. One warning remains: LOOSE_BODY, meaning the six outer bases could slide apart because no joint bolts lock them. The brief did not ask for joint bolts, so I left them out; they can be added if the surface must be fixed together.
